decisions.statement: The achievement catalog arrives as an argument rather than as an imported table.
A page's category tells the account tally apart from the character tally.
A page stating a parent is a subcategory of the page the parent names.
Headings are ordered by display order.
A character heading merges into the account heading with the same title.
An achievement the store never recorded counts as no steps done.
A character achievement rolled into the account takes the roster's best steps.
The roster is an argument the caller may give as undefined.

definition: the achievement points an account and each character have earned, counted by heading
